r2.text: Ray. Night maintenance. I wrote that on the mirror.

d2.text: Why? Mira's trying to help me.

r3.text: Then ask her why nobody she helped ever came back up.

r4.text: I started the generator. That's why the lights work.

r5.text: Patel saved my life. He locked the sick ones in the gym. Then one of them bit him.

r6.text: At midnight, twelve people got into that van.

r7.text: It never left. Engine's still running.

m1.text: Dev? Who is that with you?

r8.text: She's watching. She's always been watching.

end.text: Part six. Follow, and tell me. Ray, or Mira?
